title: Derivation of NR sidelink measurement results

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE that performs NR sidelink measurements and derives measurement results.

entities.name: Peer UE

entities.name: NR sidelink measurement procedure
entities.description: Procedure for deriving NR sidelink measurement results including RSRP measurements based on configured parameters.

entities.name: PC5-RRC connection
entities.description: The sidelink RRC connection between UEs over which measurements are performed.

entities.description: Configuration object containing parameters for NR sidelink measurements.

entities.name: sl-ReportConfig
entities.description: Configuration object containing reporting parameters for NR sidelink measurements.

entities.name: NR sidelink RSRP measurement
entities.description: Reference Signal Received Power measurement for NR sidelink communications.

relations.description: Peer UE configures the UE to perform NR sidelink measurements.
NR sidelink measurements are performed per PC5-RRC connection.
Measurement procedure uses parameters from sl-MeasObject configuration.
Measurement procedure uses parameters from sl-ReportConfig configuration.
Measurement procedure derives NR sidelink RSRP measurement results.
Measurement procedure derives measurement quantities based on NR sidelink DMRS.
Measurement procedure applies layer 3 filtering to measurement results.
